description: Renders a native <textarea> element with styled focus-visible ring. All standard textarea semantics and keyboard interactions are handled by the browser. Consumers must associate the textarea with a visible label for accessibility.

keyboard.action: Inserts a new line within the textarea

focus.notes: Focus ring uses a visible outline via focus-visible pseudo-class. Disabled textareas remove pointer events and reduce opacity.

announcements: The associated label is announced as the accessible name
Placeholder text is announced as a fallback if no label is present
The element is announced as a text area or multi-line edit field
screenReader.notes: Placeholder text alone is not a sufficient accessible name. Always pair with a label element or aria-label.

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for textarea text on background)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for border and focus ring)

consumerResponsibilities: Always associate the textarea with a <label> element using htmlFor or wrap the textarea inside a <label>
If a visible label is not possible, provide aria-label or aria-labelledby
Use aria-describedby to link helper text or error messages
Set aria-invalid="true" and aria-errormessage when the textarea is in an error state
